title: Cuautitlán, Mexico: an 18-year-old recruited with a fake Facebook job offer
summary: In July 2019 an 18-year-old woman in the State of Mexico was contacted through a fake Facebook profile and offered a job with a supposedly good hourly wage. Over 4 and 5 July 2019 she was driven by two people to hotels in Cuautitlán, Cuautitlán Izcalli and Tultitlán, where she was forced into prostitution under threats of harm and made to hand over the money. She filed a complaint; the pair were arrested and charged in late 2019. On 21 December 2021 the State of Mexico prosecutor's specialised trafficking unit announced that a judge had sentenced both to 38 years and nine months in prison and fines of 3,210,620 pesos each.
